summary: Backend-only test of the new-user changes, run through the REAL bot (js/start-bot.js on :5000 with TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL pointed at mock_telegram_api.js on :5099). New e2e js/tests/bot_onboarding_gift_resume_iter213.js: 31/32 passed. Working: /start shows 5 languages including Farsi; picking English sends the $5 teaser and then the main menu, with no email question and no intent picker; the wallet is not credited at join; Back, Main Menu, Cancel and language taps do not unlock the gift; the first Wallet or Cloud IVR tap credits $5 exactly once (one welcomeBonuses doc and one welcome-bonus transaction); existing users are unaffected; Farsi saves 'fa', shows English text, and Wallet, Back, Cloud IVR, Settings and Change Language work without errors. Auto-complete after deposit works end to end with a real domain flow: balance wall → 'Deposit $42' → resumableSessions saved → BlockBee /crypto-wallet webhook → '✅ Payment received — completing your order now…' → synthesized Complete My Order → Confirm → Yes. The order was charged once and the session was cleared. A still-short deposit does not auto-complete and keeps the session. A session older than 6h gets the old Complete My Order / Start Fresh offer. FAIL: a new user's first returning /start still shows the 'What do you need today?' intent picker. SERIOUS SIDE EFFECT: domain-pay is NOT a dry run in preview. My 2 auto-complete runs registered 2 REAL .com domains on live OpenProvider (api.openprovider.eu) and created 2 real Cloudflare zones. Regression: bot_esim_pay_first_iter208.js 33/34; the one failure is the known stale assertion A5 (k.of adds Main Menu/Cancel next to Back).

critical.issue: Domain registration is LIVE in preview, not a dry run. Testing the auto-complete flow registered iter213auto87794.com (OpenProvider ID 30541484, CF zone ede4403bf38b3b3a9ff1e101e0a54e1a) and iter213auto89550.com (OpenProvider ID 30541554, CF zone 1f0d41c20728e02e7d39c4f3194abed5), each charged by OP at $40. The records are left in the local registeredDomains/domainsOf collections (chatId 990213110) so they can be traced. Main agent: delete/cancel both on OpenProvider within the add-grace period (to get a refund) and delete the 2 CF zones; consider a DOMAIN_DRY_RUN flag for preview.

minor.issue: New joiners never set firstSessionIntentDone (the join now skips the intent picker), so their first returning /start shows the 'What do you need today?' intent picker (it is bounded by firstIntentReshown). This goes against 'products first'. Fix: set firstSessionIntentDone=true (or firstIntentReshown=true) in the join block, or drop the reshow.

The exclusion regex /^(flags)|Back|Cancel|Main Menu|Skip/i only covers English. Localized Back/Cancel/Main Menu buttons (fr 'Retour'/'Annuler', zh '返回'/'取消', hi 'वापस'/'रद्द करें', '🏠 Menu principal' etc.) and any typed free text (e.g. 'hi') will unlock the gift. The regex is also unanchored (any label containing 'Cancel' is excluded).

With a crypto deposit of exactly the shortfall ($42 USDT → $41.96 after conversion), usdBal < price, so the user gets neither the auto-complete nor any resume offer. That makes the 'Deposit $X tops up by the shortfall' promise fragile. Consider a small tolerance (e.g. <= $0.50) or re-showing the pre-filled wall when the deposit is slightly short.

Uses a fixed 2.5s setTimeout, then checks action==='walletSelectCurrencyConfirm' before tapping Yes. If the Complete handler is slower, the user is silently left on the Confirm screen. That is acceptable as a fallback, but it is not logged.

With the empty fa.js placeholder, every fa interaction logs dozens of '[i18n] Missing key … fell back to en' warnings (94 in ~10 taps): log noise in non-production. The welcome-gift message from monetization-engine has no fa text (falls back to English as expected).

critical_code_review_comments: Join block: 'const bonus = null; if (bonus?.awarded) …' is dead code; remove it
BlockBee /crypto-wallet: addFundsTo(...) is not awaited before maybeOfferResume runs (pre-existing). It only works because of later awaits; await it to be safe
monetization checkAndAwardWelcomeBonus relies on result.previouslyExisted, which the driver never returns. Idempotency really comes from the findOne pre-check plus the unique index (pre-existing)
RESUME_ORDER_CTA/RESUME_DISMISS_CTA and the auto-complete message have no 'fa' entries (fall back to en — OK for now)

rca of the issue: Intent picker on returning /start: the join block no longer calls showFirstSessionIntent, so firstSessionIntentDone is never set. The /start branch at ~15300 re-shows the picker once to any user with !firstSessionIntentDone && !firstIntentReshown && !hasPurchased. Reproduce: new user → English → /start → intent picker. Mitigation: set firstSessionIntentDone=true in the addUserLanguage join block.
